newsitem.title: GERMANY: German SPD says Jan unadj jobless hits 4.66 mln.
newsitem.headline: German SPD says Jan unadj jobless hits 4.66 mln.

text.p: Germany's opposition Social Democrats said on Thursday that unadjusted unemployment surged in January to a new post-war record of 4.66 million from 4.15 million in December.
Official data are due to be published later, but the figures are often leaked before their release.
SPD parliament deputy Ottmar Schreiner also said unemployment in western Germany had risen to 3.27 million in January from 2.96 million.
Schreiner also said that unemployment in former communist east Germany had risen to 1.39 million from 1.19 million.
It was not immediately clear whether the SPD figures were the final numbers which are to be published by the Federal Labour Office at about 0855 GMT or whether they were latest estimates.
EarlIer, newspapers reported that unadjusted unemployment would hit 4.6 million in January.

No figures have yet been released for seasonally adjusted unemployment, a figure more closely watched by economists because it reveals underlying trends. A Reuters poll showed a consensus view that adjusted joblessness would rise by 52,000 in January from December.
